A story for this moment

The lantern that kept checking the shore

A small lantern crossed a dark lake in a paper boat. It kept turning toward the shore, looking for a signal that it was still wanted.

Every time the shore stayed quiet, the lantern burned brighter. It thought that if it gave enough light, the silence would finally answer.

Then the water said, “Your light can guide you, too.” The lantern turned forward. The shore had not changed — but now the next stretch of water was visible.

MORAL

Your worth does not depend on how brightly you shine for someone else. Sometimes your own light is what helps you see the next step.
